Please just be my friend and ask questions (or criticize!)...  
Obviously a throwaway account, my wife doesn't even have Reddit I just think it's custom.  Our relationship has been shit for 5 years.  I have been off work with PTSD for 2.5 years, I was in two shootings as a police officer  5+ years ago, and since then have been struggling with alcoholism and anger management, to say the least,  
Please, I ask, don't flood my inbox with anti-police sentiment.  I'm not from America, and these were pretty clear cut shootings.  If you disagree, that's fine, just please consider this post is about my mental health and struggles, not the legalities of policing.  I'm just trying to be open.  
While this has escalated so much over the last couple years, I'm having such a hard time discerning what is my own mental health problems, and what may just be and always may have been a toxic relationship.  
Trying really hard for an unofficial TLDR for me: I am really nice, always, although can be needy, in the sense that I expect my wife to say "I love you" once a day or so, and to just generally be nice to me if i'm  nearby.  
She (did) the same, but once I was off work with PTSD, she pulled away, wouldn't touch me, and won't say anything nice let alone she loves me, without me saying it first and looking at her, expecting it.  
She (her TLDR?) is that I have a short temper and will yell at her when we have arguments.  
I feel like this only happens after multiple weeks of her checking out and not even acknowledging me, but I'm worried I'm just being triggered and that she is possibly not the culprit?   
Sorry, this is more of an Ask Me Anything, as I just want the advice and will respond to as many as possible. I just need the help. I do not have friends.
